title: Tuesday is a good day to do the hardest task first
dek: Monday is for catching up, which makes Tuesday morning a good time to start the work you have been putting off.
keywords: how to stop procrastinating at work
body: Monday usually goes to catching up. There are emails from the weekend, meetings to plan the week and a list of small things that need an answer. By the end of it, I often feel busy without having started anything important.

Tuesday feels different to me. The inbox is calmer, the week has a shape, and there is still plenty of time before Friday. That makes Tuesday morning a good time to take on the one task I have been avoiding.

I try to start it before I open email. I give it an hour with notifications off and the door closed if I can. I do not need to finish it. I just need to make real progress while my energy is still fresh.
When I do this, the rest of the day feels lighter. The hard thing is no longer sitting over my shoulder, and the smaller tasks go faster because I am not dreading anything.
This morning, pick the one task you have been putting off, and give it your first hour before anything else.
